addon.notes:
# New

## Library Mode
* Added a new inventory mode called Library which allows you to potentially view and manage all items across all inventories across all characters. Due to the sheer amount of items the mode can display, the window will expand to a larger default form factor when in this mode.

## Organize
* Improved the logic behind Organize. It should no longer require multiple runs to organize inventory and should be faster in general.
* Now shows a preview window which will display where Organize plans to move each item in each bag.
* Removed the Light Organize feature as normal Organize now does the same thing (can be used anywhere, dynamically uses the inventory bags available at the current moment).

## New Store NPC Entries
Added the following new storage options to Store NPC:
* Aurix (Ru'Lude Gardens): Black I.D. Card & Old I.D. Card
* Divainy-Gamainy (Western Adoulin): Snowtip Stone +2, Leafslit Stone, Wailing Stone +2, Snowslit Stone +2, Ghastly Stone +2, Snowdim Stone +2, Leaforb Stone +2, Snoworb Stone +1, Leafslit Stone +1, Leafslit Stone +2, Duskorb Stone +2, Duskorb Stone +1, Duskslit Stone +1
* Eternal Flame (Western Adoulin): Copper Voucher
* Fhelm Jobeizat (Windurst Woods): Copper Voucher
* Lola (Eastern Adoulin): Lebondopt Wing, Pulchridopt Wing
* Rolandienne (Southern San d'Oria): Copper Voucher
* Antiqix (Castle Oztroja): T. Whiteshell
* Lorissa (Yorcia Weald): Mellidopt Wing

## Consolidate By Preference
* Now shows progress on where items are going when running.

## General
* Added the ability to exclude characters from the Auto-drop list by clicking their name in the Drop List UI.
* //ax ah command now shows recent sales history information more accurately.

# Bugfixes
* Organize no longer tries to operate on items that are currently in the player's bazaar.
* Consolidate no longer tries to consolidate Rare items to characters who already have the item.
